description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of Member of the Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a seat vacated due to a party membership change. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes and declarations at the local government level.
